sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-int4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Introduction We're introducing Ling-3.0-flash, our next-generation native hybrid reasoning model. Operating with 124B total and 5.1B active parameters (~12.4% and ~8.1% of our previous 1T-class flagship Ring-2.6-1T), Ling-3.0-flash matches or outperforms its predecessor across key benchmarks.

sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-flash, an inclusionai 124B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, demonstrates strong performance in speed, typically ranking among the fastest models with a 78th percentile across eight benchmarks.

sources.title: inclusionai Ling 3.0 Flash Fin (free) - Pricing & Benchmarks 2026
sources.snippet: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin (free) by inclusionai excels in the Coding category, where it ranks #232 with a composite score of 40/100. Ling 3.0 Flash Fin is a finance-focused mixture-of-experts model from InclusionAI, built on Ling 3.0 Flash with 5.1B active parameters out of 124B total.

sources.title: Ling 3.0 Flash | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-flash is a 124B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model with about 5.1B parameters activated per token. It is built for token efficiency and production-scale agentic inference, supporting a 262K token context window for text-based conversation, coding, and tool-driven workflows.
